meta.title: LED Light Therapy in Idaho Falls | Rosemary Esthetics
meta.description: New at Rosemary Esthetics in Idaho Falls: LED light therapy, a $5 add-on. Calming light sessions that support clear, healthy-looking skin.

hero.heading: LED Light Therapy
hero.lead: The newest treatment at the studio. Gentle, non-invasive light therapy that feels like nothing more than warm relaxation, and supports calm, clear, healthy-looking skin over a series of sessions.

items.text: LED Light Therapy add-on: {{PRICE}}. Just add it to any facial at your visit or when booking.
Zero downtime. No needles, no heat damage, no recovery. You can go straight back to your day.
Best as an add-on: a lovely finishing touch on any facial.
Tell us first if you're using photosensitizing medication, so we can make sure LED is right for you.

steps.title: Cleanse
steps.body: Skin is cleansed so light reaches it effectively.

steps.title: Light session
steps.body: You relax under the LED panel with eye protection. It's completely painless, most clients find it deeply calming.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Serum, moisturizer, and SPF to lock in the session.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.body: LED works best as a series. We'll suggest a simple cadence at your visit.
